reason: An acceptance-driven DeepSeek Harness plugin that independently evaluates tests, builds, files, Git state, HTTP checks, and other criteria, then drives repair attempts or certifies verified completion.

summaries.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的验收驱动插件，可独立检查测试、构建和其他项目标准，并在满足必选条件后生成完成认证。
summaries.en: An acceptance-driven DeepSeek Harness plugin that independently checks tests, builds, and other project criteria before certifying completion.

capabilities: Runs configured command evaluators when explicitly authorized
Reads project files and Git workspace state
Performs HTTP checks with documented localhost restrictions
Steers agent turns and blocks or completes Harness goals
Produces completion certificates and structured evaluation results
